# lsp-framework in Kex

This directory vendors [leon-bckl/lsp-framework](https://github.com/leon-bckl/lsp-framework)
at commit `bd346e5b55505b6d99730e5de9bfc8c5075ece14` (2026-08-13).

Kex uses it for JSON-RPC transport, generated Language Server Protocol types,
message dispatch, and URI handling. Upstream's MIT license is retained in
`LICENSE`.
